DLC2317:3:t_1:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Time apart nurtures love, and that love burns all the brighter when two people meet again...」

DLC2317:3:t_1:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The tale I am about to tell takes place after $$かなめ$$'s rescue.」

DLC2317:3:t_1:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Reunited with $$かなめ$$, $$宗介$$ and the others told her about the battles they had fought.」

DLC2317:3:t_1:9.en: ~$$マクロス・クォーター$$: Briefing Room~

DLC2317:3:t_1:10.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...You guys went through a lot too, huh, $$宗介$$?」

DLC2317:3:t_1:11.en:
$$宗介$$
「That is all behind us now.」

DLC2317:3:t_1:12.en:
$$アルト$$
「It's a little early to say that. We've still got plenty of trouble ahead.」

DLC2317:3:t_1:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「No problem. There is nothing left for me to fear.」

DLC2317:3:t_1:15.en:
$$アルト$$
「So this is the power of love, huh?」

DLC2317:3:t_1:16.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Oh, come on! Both of you!」

DLC2317:3:t_1:17.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Well... After a reunion as passionate as yours, can you blame us?」

DLC2317:3:t_1:18.en:
$$クラン$$
「But it was moving! Even I couldn't help shedding a few tears!」

DLC2317:3:t_1:20.en:
$$マオ$$
「I never thought we'd see the day when we could laugh like this...」

DLC2317:3:t_1:21.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Yeah. Back when we were under pressure day after day, everyone was on edge.」

DLC2317:3:t_1:22.en:
$$カレン$$
「You can say that again. Watching that showdown between $$ミスリル$$ and $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ had me sweating bullets.」

DLC2317:3:t_1:24.en:
$$アルト$$
「Oh, yeah. That did happen, didn't it?」

DLC2317:3:t_1:25.en:
$$宗介$$
「It has been almost exactly a month since then...」

DLC2317:3:t_2:3.en: ~$$マクロス・クォーター$$: Hangar~

DLC2317:3:t_2:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「A lack of problems is good news for both the watch and the unit.」

DLC2317:3:t_2:8.en:
$$クルツ$$
「You don't have to tell me that.」

DLC2317:3:t_2:9.en:
$$クラン$$
「If only the night could pass without incident and the world could go on to find peace...」

DLC2317:3:t_2:10.en:
$$マオ$$
「Well, if we suddenly had complete peace, we'd be out of a job.」

DLC2317:3:t_2:11.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Out of a job? Wasn't $$ミスリル$$ already wiped out...?」

DLC2317:3:t_2:12.en:
$$マオ$$
「Well, yes... We're employed by $c at the moment, but once that contract ends, we're suddenly unemployed.」

DLC2317:3:t_2:13.en:
$$アルト$$
「How about this? Why don't the $$ミスリル$$ members here just join $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$?」

DLC2317:3:t_2:14.en:
$$クラン$$
「Excellent idea! Your position would hardly change, and it would let us expand our operations!」

DLC2317:3:t_2:15.en:
$$マオ$$
「Give me a break. $$ミスリル$$ may be out of business for now, but $$テッサ$$ and the rest of us aren't about to let it end here.」

DLC2317:3:t_2:16.en:
$$クルツ$$
「That's right. Why don't you guys join $$ミスリル$$ instead?」

DLC2317:3:t_2:17.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「You want us at $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ to join you?」

DLC2317:3:t_2:18.en:
$$宗介$$
「A sound plan. Training at $$ミスリル$$'s boot camp would turn you into proper soldiers.」

DLC2317:3:t_2:19.en:
$$アルト$$
「You make it sound like we're a bunch of amateurs...!」

DLC2317:3:t_2:20.en:
$$宗介$$
「As I see it, $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ is somewhat lax in matters of discipline.」

DLC2317:3:t_2:21.en:
$$クラン$$
「I think $$ミスリル$$ is the strange organization, making a sheltered boy raised on battlefields attend high school.」

DLC2317:3:t_2:22.en:
$$マオ$$
「I agree with half of that, but I won't stand for you treating all of $$ミスリル$$ like a comedy troupe because of it.」

DLC2317:3:t_2:23.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Let's stop this. There's no point fighting over an organization that doesn't exist anymore.」

DLC2317:3:t_2:24.en:
$$クルツ$$
「What's that, $$ミシェル$$? Are you trying to pick a fight?」

DLC2317:3:t_2:25.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「That isn't what I mean. I'm saying it would be more realistic for $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ to absorb $$ミスリル$$.」

DLC2317:3:t_2:26.en:
$$マオ$$
「$$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ must be desperately short of personnel. An organization like that can't have much of a future, can it?」

DLC2317:3:t_2:28.en:
$$マオ$$
「You want a piece of me!? You're the ones who started this!」

DLC2317:3:t_2:29.en:
$$アルト$$
「We were just trying to help!」

DLC2317:3:t_2:31.en:
$$アルト$$
「I don't want to hear that from a guy who calls himself a bodyguard and turns peaceful everyday life into one big explosive punch line!」

DLC2317:3:t_2:32.en:
$$宗介$$
「Everything I do is to protect $$千鳥$$.」

DLC2317:3:t_2:33.en:
$$アルト$$
「That's exactly the kind of unwanted help I'm talking about!」

DLC2317:3:t_2:34.en:
$$マオ$$
「You got a problem with $$ミスリル$$'s operations?」

DLC2317:3:t_2:35.en:
$$クラン$$
「I am telling you that the entire premise of that operation is absurd!」

DLC2317:3:t_2:36.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「You're wasting your breath, $$クラン$$.」

DLC2317:3:t_2:37.en:
$$クルツ$$
「You might have a point, but having you say it to our faces like this really pisses me off.」

DLC2317:3:t_2:44.en:
$$ルカ$$
「It's nothing terribly important, but apparently a group of terrorists is hiding in an abandoned Federation base twenty kilometers north of here.」

DLC2317:3:t_2:46.en:
$$ルカ$$
「They're closer to bandits, really. They apparently have a fair amount of firepower, so the $$連邦軍$$ are planning to move in and eliminate them soon.」

DLC2317:3:t_2:49.en:
$$マオ$$
「We've got some frustration to work off. Let's wipe them out and show the world $$ミスリル$$ is still alive and kicking.」

DLC2317:3:t_2:50.en:
$$宗介$$
「Volunteer work, then. It has been a while since our last club activity.」

DLC2317:3:t_2:51.en:
$$アルト$$
「Don't go making that decision right in front of your club president.」

DLC2317:3:t_2:52.en:
$$クラン$$
「We cannot leave this to $$ミスリル$$. $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ will deploy as well.」

DLC2317:3:t_2:55.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ルカ$$, I'm counting on you to hold the fort.」

DLC2317:3:t_2:56.en:
$$宗介$$
「If Captain $$オズマ$$ asks any questions, please make up a suitable answer.」

DLC2317:3:t_2:58.en:
$$マオ$$
「That's fine by me. We'll show $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ what we're made of by taking out those terrorists.」

DLC2317:3:t_2:59.en:
$$クラン$$
「Very well! You're on, $$ミスリル$$!」

DLC2317:3:t_3:3.en: ~$$マクロス・クォーター$$: Briefing Room~

DLC2317:3:t_3:5.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Even we were surprised by how $$宗介$$ and the others transformed. Sure, it was to fool Major $$オズマ$$, but they changed just like that.」

review.context: Kaname hears a flashback about an argument between Mithril and S.M.S. during hangar watch; both groups leave to compete against bandits.
decisions: Preserved the difference between Captain Ozma as a role and Major Ozma as a rank.
Mao is inviting her own group to take action against the bandits; Luca is asked to cover for them.
